name: Budget Slider: Bath Morph
description: One-room compositing: a single bathroom shell (3 finish variants of the SAME room via images.edit) + 12 isolated object cutouts in fixed slots. Budget slider ($6K-$25K) crosses 7 thresholds; each swaps/adds INDIVIDUAL objects with pop animations (LED mirror, oak vanity, towel warmer + plant, stone walls, freestanding tub, floating vanity, marble suite + glass shower). Ends with locked style + estimate CTA.
